null_denominator_only_independent_numera.note: Real depth + real |d18O| increments resampled from their own marginals against the real age grid. This isolates what the shared 1/dAge factor produces with NO real pairing.

verdict.statement: The shared 1/dAge factor alone generates a correlation of 0.330 between LSR and |d(d18O)/d(age)| from numerators that are pure resamples with no real pairing, i.e. 70% of the observed 0.475. The numerator-level correlation, which shares no denominator, is +0.106 and is positive at every contiguous block width tested. The relationship is therefore denominator-dominated but not denominator-exhausted: a weak residual coupling between sediment accumulation and proxy variability survives. Reviews that permuted the d18O VALUES rather than the increments reported the relationship as fully explained; that construction also changes the marginal spread of the numerator and is the less faithful null.
